status_note: every row of the sheet has a valid julgamento
invalid_labels_rule: a filled julgamento outside the labels of its question is not counted and is listed here; the report is interim while any row is empty or invalid
units: precision per UDV; the judgment of an item counts for each of its UDVs

label_semantics.trecho_sustenta: one annotator's reading of whether the passage, spoken by the participant, supports the statement the LDS attributes to them; it says nothing about whether the statement is true in the world
label_semantics.strict_precision: share of judged UDVs of a stratum marked correta
label_semantics.tolerant_precision: share of judged UDVs of a stratum marked correta or parcial
label_semantics.pessoa_falou: whether the transcript records words spoken by the participant; a no_evidence or person_not_resolved UDV is counted correct when the answer is nao_falou, and nao_sei is left out of every denominator
label_semantics.false_absence_rate: share of decided speaker_check answers that are falou, i.e. the participant spoke but the pipeline recorded no usable speech
label_semantics.population: N_h is the number of UDVs of stratum h in the sampled splits, frozen in the key when the sample was drawn

criteria_declaration: Declared before any human judgment of this sample exists. The criteria are copied into annotation_key.json when the sample is drawn, and the precision report flags any later change. PASS requires the Wilson lower bound of the stated metric, at the report confidence level, to reach min_wilson_lower on the stated stratum.

udv_v2_unchanged.rule: an item inherits its udv_v1 label for udv_v2 when every UDV of the item has the same evidence text, start_char, end_char and speaker_turn in both runs (or no evidence in both); otherwise the passage shown to the annotator is not the udv_v2 passage and the item needs a new judgment
udv_v2_unchanged.caveat: the inherited items are the udv_v1 items whose evidence did not change; they are not a random sample of the udv_v2 strata, so their precision describes that subset only

udv_v2.rule: udv_v2 precision per stratum from every item of the udv_v1 sample: an item whose udv_v2 evidence is same, superset or no_evidence (inheritance section of the supplementary key) keeps its judgment from the udv_v1 sheet, and a moved item counts only with its judgment from the supplementary sheet; the stratum of an item is the stratum of its udv_v2 records, and the population is the udv_v2 count of the sampled splits

relation_rules.same: the udv_v2 evidence has the start_char, end_char and speaker_turn of the udv_v1 evidence
relation_rules.superset: same speaker_turn, udv_v2 start_char <= udv_v1 start_char and udv_v2 end_char >= udv_v1 end_char, not same: the udv_v2 passage holds the whole udv_v1 passage and adds text of the same turn
relation_rules.moved: any other case: another turn, a udv_v2 passage that leaves out part of the udv_v1 passage, or evidence in one run only
relation_rules.no_evidence: no evidence in either run (the pessoa_falou items); the item keeps its udv_v1 label, as in the annotation plan

inheritance.inheritance_rule: an item whose relation is in inherit_relations, or no_evidence, keeps its udv_v1 human label for udv_v2; only the moved items get a row in the supplementary sheet
inheritance.justification: the text added to a superset passage belongs to the same speaker turn, so the text that supported a udv_v1 passage judged correta is still in the udv_v2 passage, and a passage judged parcial or incorreta can only keep or improve its support when text of the same speaker is added
inheritance.consequence: the udv_v2 precision is conservative with respect to the superset items judged parcial or incorreta in udv_v1, whose udv_v2 label could be better than the inherited one
inheritance.assumption: adding a sentence of the same speaker turn does not turn a passage that supports the statement into one that does not

caveats: the items were drawn from the udv_v1 strata; an item that changed stratum in udv_v2 keeps the inclusion probability of its udv_v1 stratum, so the udv_v2 strata are not simple random samples of the udv_v2 populations
udv_v2 UDVs of a stratum whose udv_v1 stratum was sampled at another rate, or not drawn, are represented only through the items that were drawn
the supplementary rows show opinions the annotator already judged with their udv_v1 passage, so their judgments are not independent of the first sheet
a superset item keeps a udv_v1 label given to a shorter passage; the inheritance section states the assumption this rests on

sensitivity.rule: the report also gives the precision with the superset items counted only when their udv_v1 label is correta (the others are left out of the denominator), next to the precision with every superset item inherited
